name: service_interval_reset
intent: Reset the instrument cluster's service-interval counters after a service (next-service distance and days back to the interval, last-service date to today).
status_note: Research is in progress. steps is EMPTY on purpose: no bytes are invented. Fill steps (from published documentation, open-source code or a published trace) in CUORE_STATE_DIR/procedures/service_interval_reset.json; cite it in source.

session.note: bus and bitrate are the confirmed CAN-C values; the diagnostic session (0x10 sub-function) comes with the source steps

read_back.label: DID ids from service_dids discovery candidates; unconfirmed until one changes after a real reset

preconditions.label: engine off: from MES prompts
preconditions.voltage_note: recorded by the owner at run time; not assumed

postconditions.label: from MES prompts / assumed unchanged
postconditions.note: ignition cycled and values re-read per the verification rule

verification_rule: Read the three quantities before and after. PASS only if next-service km = 16000 and days = 365 (the interval values) and last-service date = the run date, in the DIDs read live; an unchanged read-back means the reset did not take.
